newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cons Rutile says Sierra Leone workers safe.
newsitem.headline: Cons Rutile says Sierra Leone workers safe.

text.p: Consolidated Rutile Ltd said on Tuesday it understood its employees in Sierra Leone were safe following a coup on Sunday that toppled the West African nation's year-old government

"Sierra Rutile Ltd understands from information received today that its employees in Freetown and at the minesite in southern Sierra Leone are safe following the coup in that country on Sunday 25th May," Consolidated Rutile said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.

Sierra Rutile and its two shareholders, Consolidated Rutile and Nord Resources (Corp) of the United States, have been evaluating the mine and market opportunities for mineral sand since resecuring the mine in January 1996, Faulkner said.
The mine was overrun by rebels in January 1995.
The companies each own a 50 percent stake in the mine.
Consolidated Rutile is 50.1 percent owned by Cudgen RZ Ltd, which in turn is about 77 percent owned by RGC.
Soldiers seized power in Sierra Leone on Sunday.
